templateCaptureAnyBranch.description:
Whether a template capture also takes a passed `pull_request` run and a run on a branch
that is not the default branch (kiln ADR-0110 §Update 2026-11-19). With it on, any person
who can push a branch of a repository can write the repository's captured templates.

PublicEffectiveCacheCaps.description: The effective cache cap of every cache type, in GiB.

(ADR-0086 §Update 2026-11-13).
